signalId.description: Unique identifier of the matching real-world signal

status.description: The current state of the interactive debate loop

agentName.description: The name of the agent submitting the debate turn

role.description: The conversational role of the agent in this turn

arguments.description: Claims and points supporting the agent's position

counterArguments.description: Objections or responses targeting other agents' arguments

questions.description: Questions directed to other agents in the debate session

responses.description: Answers to questions raised by other agents in prior turns

vote.description: The recommended final decision (optional until responder phase)

confidence.description: The agent's confidence score for their final position

turns.description: The sequence of debate turns submitted by cognitive agents
